annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1680 correcting the Czech language version of Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on the harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1680 correcting the Czech language version of Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on the harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 257/47
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision correcting errors in the Czech version of Decision 2019/436 on harmonised machinery standards under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. It concerns the presumption of conformity with essential health and safety requirements. Other language versions are unaffected; it enters into force on the twentieth day after publication.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects Czech version of Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 (Article 1 para 2 and Article 2).
Concerns presumption of conformity with Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC essential health and safety requirements.
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication in the OJ.
